description: Rewrite all data files to be truthful to Muhammad Attique's real resume and map projects to the 6 real public GitHub repos. Covers src/data/profile.js, src/data/experience.js, src/data/skills.js, src/data/projects.js, and the hardcoded project count in src/pages/ProjectDetail.jsx. Also adds profile.voiceIntro (consumed later by FEAT-003). Must preserve every field name the section components read and the projects helper exports so no route breaks. Depends on nothing, but FEAT-003 depends on this (needs profile.voiceIntro).
steps: src/data/profile.js: set location:'Rawalpindi, Pakistan'; set phone:'' (empty string, remove the TODO comment); rewrite bio[] by paraphrasing the professional summary (CS undergraduate, full-stack + backend experience, microservices, real-time socket apps, AI-driven data pipelines, software engineering internship covering backend/DevOps/CI/CD, strong OOP/DSA/networking) and REMOVE the fabricated 'Tavern' sentence; replace stats[] with honest recruiter-credible values, e.g. {value:'3.84',label:'CGPA'}, {value:'15+',label:'GitHub Projects'}, {value:'1',label:'SW Engineering Internship'} (keep value/label/description shape used by About.section.jsx); set socials to ONLY GitHub {href:'https://github.com/muhammadattiique', username:'@muhammadattiique'} and the existing LinkedIn entry — REMOVE the 'X / Twitter' object; ADD voiceIntro: "Hi, I am Muhammad Attique, a Full-Stack Developer and Software Engineer from Pakistan. I build high-performance web applications with React and Tailwind, scalable backend services with Java, Spring Boot, and Kafka, and interactive three-D experiences on the web. I love turning complex systems into clean, reliable products. Welcome to my portfolio — take a look at my work."; keep all other keys (name, firstName, lastName, role, tagline, shortIntro, status, city, country, timezone, email, resumeUrl, services). Soften fabricated flourishes like '60fps' in services copy to stay honest.

src/data/experience.js: delete the 'tavern' entry entirely. Keep ONE work entry: {id:'planet-beyond', role:'Software Engineer Intern', company:'Planet Beyond Pvt. Ltd', duration:'Jul 2026 – Sep 2026', isCurrent:false, location:'Islamabad / Rawalpindi, Pakistan', description:..., highlights:[Java/Spring Boot/Kafka backend + microservices + event-driven + Docker; React.js/Tailwind/React Native frontend; Jenkins CI/CD, Ubuntu/Rocky Linux deployment, Kubernetes fundamentals], tags:['Java','Spring Boot','Kafka','Docker','React.js','React Native','Jenkins','CI/CD','Kubernetes','Linux']}. Update education[0] to degree:'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (In Progress)', institution:'PMAS Arid Agriculture University Rawalpindi', location:'Rawalpindi, Pakistan', duration:'09/2023 – 05/2027 (expected)', details mentioning CGPA 3.84/4.00, 6 semesters completed, and relevant coursework. Keep exact field names consumed by Experience.section.jsx.

src/data/skills.js: align the 4 categories to the real resume while keeping the {number,title,description,skills:[{name,category,level}]} shape and the marqueeSkills flat array. Category 1 Languages/Web: C++, Java, Python, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, React, Tailwind CSS, PHP, Spring Boot, React Native. Category 2 Backend & Systems / Core: Data Structures, Algorithms, OOP, File Handling, MySQL, SQL, Socket Programming. Category 3 keep 'Creative Web & 3D' (Three.js, React Three Fiber, @react-three/drei, WebGL, Web Audio API) with honest levels. Category 4 Tools & Networking: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Docker, Jenkins, Kubernetes (fundamentals), Cisco Packet Tracer, IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, Computer Networks, IP Addressing, VLANs, Linux. Use honest level values (mix of Intermediate/Proficient; reserve 'Advanced' for genuinely core skills). Update marqueeSkills to drop anything no longer claimed (e.g. Next.js) and reflect the real stack.

src/data/projects.js: replace the projects array with 6 entries IN THIS ORDER, keeping the full object shape (id, slug, number, title, subtitle, year, role, client, category, featured, tags, coverImage, gallery, summary, overview, challenge, solution, results[], github, live) and keeping getProjectBySlug + getAdjacentProjects unchanged. (1) slug 'multi-client-chat', number '01', Multi-Client Chat Application, Python/socket/threading, github 'https://github.com/muhammadattiique/MultiClient-Chat-Application-Python-', coverImage '/projects/multi-client-chat.svg', featured true. (2) slug 'bank-management', number '02', Bank Management System, C++/OOP/file handling, github 'https://github.com/muhammadattiique/Bank_Management_System-with-cpp', coverImage '/projects/bank-management.svg', featured true. (3) slug 'secure-voting', number '03', Secure Voting System, C++/file handling/Caesar cipher/CNIC auth, github 'https://github.com/muhammadattiique/Secure_Voting_System-with-cpp', coverImage '/projects/bank-management.svg' (reuse), featured true. (5) slug 'student-management', number '05', Student Management System, Python, github 'https://github.com/muhammadattiique/Student_Management_System', coverImage '/projects/multi-client-chat.svg' (reuse), featured false. (6) slug 'weather-application', number '06', Weather Application, HTML/CSS/JS/OpenWeather API, github 'https://github.com/muhammadattiique/Weather-Application', coverImage '/projects/shopping-cart.svg' (reuse), featured false. For every project set live:null, gallery to an array containing only its coverImage, and write honest case-study copy (summary/overview/challenge/solution/results) with NO invented metrics (no '60fps', no 'sub-millisecond', no fake bundle sizes). Only reference the 4 SVGs that exist in public/projects.
src/pages/ProjectDetail.jsx: change the hardcoded '{project.number} / 04' breadcrumb to '{project.number} / 06'.
acceptance_criteria: Grep of src/data/ for 'Tavern' returns zero matches.
Grep of src/data/profile.js shows phone set to empty string and a voiceIntro field present, and no 'X / Twitter' social.
src/data/projects.js has exactly 6 projects numbered 01..06 with the specified slugs, every coverImage/gallery path is one of the 4 existing SVGs, and every live value is null.
getProjectBySlug and getAdjacentProjects are still exported and unchanged in signature.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm it exits 0 (catches any broken import or JSX reference across the data consumers).

Run `npm run dev` and load '/', '/projects', and at least '/projects/multi-client-chat' and '/projects/weather-application' — confirm cards render, filters work, and prev/next navigation works with no console errors.
Grep src/ for 'Tavern', 'X / Twitter', and the regex '/ 04' in ProjectDetail.jsx and confirm zero matches; grep projects.js for any SVG filename not in the allowed 4 and confirm none.
findings: Rewrote all data files to match the real resume and GitHub repos. Final project slug list (6, numbered 01-06): multi-client-chat (01), bank-management (02), secure-voting (03), online-shopping-cart (04), student-management (05), weather-application (06). Every coverImage/gallery path uses one of the existing public/projects SVGs (multi-client-chat.svg, bank-management.svg, shopping-cart.svg); secure-voting reuses bank-management.svg, student-management reuses multi-client-chat.svg, weather-application reuses shopping-cart.svg. All live values are null; getProjectBySlug and getAdjacentProjects are unchanged. profile.voiceIntro WAS ADDED with the exact FEAT-002 script (consumed by FEAT-003). profile.phone set to empty string, 'X / Twitter' social removed (and also removed from src/components/ui/CommandPalette.jsx, the only other src/ reference, to satisfy the src/ grep). experience.js: Tavern removed, single Planet Beyond Pvt. Ltd intern entry kept, education updated (CGPA 3.84, in progress). skills.js aligned to resume (Next.js/TypeScript dropped). ProjectDetail.jsx breadcrumb changed from '/ 04' to '/ 06'. Verification: `npm run build` exit 0, `npm run lint` 0 errors (5 pre-existing warnings only), vite preview returned 200 for '/', '/projects', '/projects/multi-client-chat', '/projects/weather-application'. Greps confirm zero 'Tavern', zero 'X / Twitter', zero '/ 04' in ProjectDetail.jsx, and no projects.js SVG path outside the allowed set.
